title: Fastify #5841: req.hostname throws if Host header is missing

error_signal.message: fastify TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'indexOf') when accessing request.hostname with missing Host header

ground_truth.root_cause_description: request.hostname getter accesses host header without null check. When Host header is missing, indexOf is called on undefined.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add fallback to empty string when host header is missing
